cases.description: Microsoft's documented worked example: the hyperbolic cotangent of 2
cases.expected_note: Microsoft's page publishes this example's result to three decimals as 1.037. Independently derived from the documented relationship coth(x) = 1/tanh(x) = (e^x + e^-x)/(e^x - e^-x): 1/math.tanh(2) = 1.0373147207275482 -> 1.037314721 at 9 dp, agreeing with the published 1.037 at the depth the page prints

cases.description: The hyperbolic cotangent of -2, which must be the negative of that of +2
cases.expected_note: coth is an odd function: (e^-x + e^x)/(e^-x - e^x) is the negative of (e^x + e^-x)/(e^x - e^-x), so COTH(-2) must be exactly -COTH(2). Verified independently: 1/math.tanh(-2) = -1.0373147207275482

cases.description: An argument at the documented magnitude limit of 2^27
cases.expected_note: Excel documents: "The absolute value of Number must be less than 2^27" and "If Number is outside its constraints, COTH returns the #NUM! error value." 2^27 = 134217728 is exactly the excluded boundary. Mathematically coth(134217728) is indistinguishable from 1, so this case tests the documented range check rather than the arithmetic. EXECUTED RESULT: all four LibreOffice builds return 1 instead of the documented error, i.e. they answer the mathematics and ignore the range check
Excel documents: "If Number is a non-numeric value, COTH returns the #VALUE! error value."
